| **SIGNATURES VERIFIED!** What a great month! Today, we learned that the initial sponsorship signatures for our Constitutional Carry for Oregon (CCFO) effort have been verified by the Oregon Secretary of State's Office, and we indeed **met the required threshold!** IP-21 is now with the Attorney General's Office for the generation of a ballot title. That title has to come back to us by May 4. Hopefully, there are no legal challenges involved with the title, and we can move smoothly into the main signature-gathering phase. As anti-2A as our AG is, I'm personally prepared for the worst but hoping for the best.

**LARS LARSON**. We continue to generate earned media, particularly on the Portland market's Fox Channel, and one of our chief petitioners, Jean Sampson, took her first stab at a [statewide radio interview](https://KerryMcQuisten.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8a6f5300a53ab781de615e5a1&id=8b87d8fcd9&e=ae2345792a) last week. She rocked it. I knew she would. Our third chief petitioner, Joel Pawloski, was the guest speaker at an AMAC Action meeting this week.

**THE NRA ANNUAL MEETING. ** I have to thank the wonderful outgoing First Vice President of the NRA Willes K. Lee for showing Oregon what exceptional outreach looks like! It was fabulous seeing him again. I traveled with the Oregon Republican Party's National Committeeman to the RNC Solomon Yue to Indianapolis. My goal: to lobby for CCFO. Oregon NEEDS to be the next Constitutional Carry state, and I can't think of a friendlier audience than 80,000 2A-loving Americans! We met some amazing future donors and keynote speakers for fundraising events, and listened to some excellent speakers. (Governor Kristi Noem, Vivek Ramaswami, Jim Jordan...)

**PRESIDENT TRUMP. **During my run for governor, I was able to meet with Eric Trump and talk about Oregon's future. Now we've had a similar conversation with President Trump himself. Solomon has been working toward an Oregon Trump rally for a while now. (It took FOUR YEARS to get a Reagan rally in Oregon!) The President and his campaign staff were gracious enough to schedule a meeting and photo for us in between the NRA excitement, and the President's words to us were, "Let's do it." We all shook hands again and Solomon said, "We have a deal." My network in Oregon is beyond thrilled! It's time to flip this state red again. (Yes, there has been follow-up since. We're doing this!)

The stakes in this U.S. Senate race are high.**** Joe Manchin and I have known one another for a very long time, but I’m afraid I cannot stomach the idea of him serving in the Senate any longer. With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

| SENATOR REEVES VICTORIOUS IN TONIGHT'S SD28 CANDIDATE'S FORUM
---
| Culpeper, Virginia - April 27, 2023 - Today, Senator Bryce Reeves participated in a forum-style debate with his opponent for the 28th Senatorial District nomination contest. The forum covered a wide variety of topics such as the Second Amendment, education, parental rights, agribusiness, and economic development. Reeves made a strong showing tonight, with clear and distinct answers both focused on what he has accomplished during his time in the legislature and what the future holds for the 28th district. “I’m glad so many people were able to take the time to come out tonight,” said Reeves. “I believe that this was one of the strongest showings of support I have ever seen at an event like this. There's a reason my opponent refuses to discuss policy and differentiate himself from my stances, and instead resorts to baseless attacks to gain support. Tonight was a prime example of this, and I am proud that the voters of the 28th district have refused to fall for my opponent's divisive rhetoric, and instead are focusing on the results I continue to produce in Richmond.”###Bryce Reeves is a small business owner, former Army Ranger, and former Prince William County narcotics detective. Senator Reeves is running for re-election into the newly formed 28th Senate District. The counties within this district include: Orange, Culpeper, Madison, Greene, Rappahannock, Fauquier (part), and Spotsylvania (part). Senator Reeves currently serves on the Senate Committee on Rehabilitation and Social Services and sits on the Committees on Local Government, General Laws and Technology, and Privileges and Elections. In addition, Senator Reeves is the Co-chair of the Virginia General Assembly Military and Veterans Caucus. Senator Reeves resides in Spotsylvania County.

clean_body: Today, Senator Bryce Reeves participated in a forum-style debate | | | | | | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEContactNICK DUBERNICK@brycereeves.com | SENATOR REEVES VICTORIOUS IN TONIGHT'S SD28 CANDIDATE'S FORUM | Culpeper, Virginia - April 27, 2023 - Today, Senator Bryce Reeves participated in a forum-style debate with his opponent for the 28th Senatorial District nomination contest. The forum covered a wide variety of topics such as the Second Amendment, education, parental rights, agribusiness, and economic development. Reeves made a strong showing tonight, with clear and distinct answers both focused on what he has accomplished during his time in the legislature and what the future holds for the 28th district. “I’m glad so many people were able to take the time to come out tonight,” said Reeves. “I believe that this was one of the strongest showings of support I have ever seen at an event like this. There's a reason my opponent refuses to discuss policy and differentiate himself from my stances, and instead resorts to baseless attacks to gain support. Tonight was a prime example of this, and I am proud that the voters of the 28th district have refused to fall for my opponent's divisive rhetoric, and instead are focusing on the results I continue to produce in Richmond.”###Bryce Reeves is a small business owner, former Army Ranger, and former Prince William County narcotics detective. Senator Reeves is running for re-election into the newly formed 28th Senate District. The counties within this district include: Orange, Culpeper, Madison, Greene, Rappahannock, Fauquier (part), and Spotsylvania (part). Senator Reeves currently serves on the Senate Committee on Rehabilitation and Social Services and sits on the Committees on Local Government, General Laws and Technology, and Privileges and Elections. In addition, Senator Reeves is the Co-chair of the Virginia General Assembly Military and Veterans Caucus. name: Deroy Murdock
subject: How do you see the Supreme Court?
body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from Deroy Murdock is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zakq6km9ihnet96v7dlpqumrn6kgaf0ur16cu9tg_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjm6o31clh2bs)
---
| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zfi0rrb6ucgv51agl7854js3vdclfstqnjp592po_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjm6o31clh2bs) [NO](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z081b9dqgqnrn0jvrb9sinae86turcmrqbtggdh0_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjm6o31clh2bs) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2znqavlkl8f653pep4692cii60rtr0pbf3skel000_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjm6o31clh2bs)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z8cnsfdrh3lb5j7sodfjhg998fqgs26be6rfn2d8_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjm6o31clh2bs)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

name: American Update
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future.

This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c665389%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=UyXgtLZeBh2oO2CZoclZoA&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c665380%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vQtB%2bsSFEbBiWA2qvj%2b30A&sysid=1) For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale’s American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** [https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c665380%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vQtB%2bsSFEbBiWA2qvj%2b30A&sysid=1) And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

body:

| | | | **China's "Redback" Could Soon Make Your IRA or 401(k) Obsolete**
---
**China's "Redback" Could Soon Make Your IRA or 401(k) Obsolete**
| | |
China and Russia are making moves that could radically harm the retirement plans of millions of Americans.

They want to REPLACE the U.S. Dollar with the "Redback", their own **gold-backed reserve currency**.

Under normal circumstances, the world would reject such a currency from these two troublesome countries.

But many predict **the Redback could actually succeed**.

Why? Because of the outlandish money printing and dollar devaluation coming from Washington. Which harms other countries' currencies and leaves many leaders secretly hoping for an alternative.

_And if it does replace the USD, what would happen to our economy?_

Here are three things you should prepare for:

name: ICYMI News
subject: How do you see the Supreme Court?
body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2bledof3ddgl0np9hk5pj3513fi3oen9anb8feg_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjmeo71c3h2bs)
---
| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zv34ukb61dos9hcf5t6pvo9hodi60f4uq0g4dnbo_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjmeo71c3h2bs) [NO](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z4kgkkuuv0csgg15i40tk169bmp9p7s1galpk1eg_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjmeo71c3h2bs) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zse44gte4ivkqmk661smgjm3ehhpclgqtm7c49qo_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjmeo71c3h2bs)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zogakk0vh72mjlv0pual7je2lno5adoqmtguu86o_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjmeo71c3h2bs)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

subject: It’s me vs. Joe Manchin
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jim Justice for U
body:
As the governor of West Virginia, a business owner, and a job creator, I know a thing or two about government overreach. Right now, Washington is out of control, and that's in large part because Joe Manchin hasn't stood up to Chuck Schumer.

| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zgatfjvufgj0ju5pr17mom6uo989ncdpufbi244o_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjm9or1c1h2bs)
---
Fellow Conservative,

This is West Virginia Governor Jim Justice. I'm writing tonight to let you know that after six highly successful years as governor of the Mountain State, **I 'm launching my campaign to be the next United States senator for West Virginia**.

[** STAND WITH ME
HELP ME UNSEAT JOE MANCHIN-> **](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0i92kfmf8h5e3p0kjfebig9sng9cknu3tqk5id0_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjm9or1c1h2bs)
I thought long and hard about whether to enter this race. After a lot of prayer and consultation with my family, the conclusion we kept coming to was that **I must do this not only for the people of West Virginia but for every American**.

The stakes in this U.S. Senate race are high.**** Joe Manchin and I have known one another for a very long time, but I'm afraid I cannot stomach the idea of him serving in the Senate any longer. As much as I like Joe Manchin on a personal level, **as long as he represents West Virginia in DC, Chuck Schumer will continue to rule over the Senate with an iron fist.**

**I 'm getting into this critical Senate race because we cannot allow a Democrat from a ruby-red state to play kingmaker in D.C. any longer.**
Joe Biden and Chuck Schumer's agenda is too disastrous; we must take action TODAY. If you want to see this Senate seat flip Republican,**[can I count on you to chip in $10 to help me unseat Joe Manchin today?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9c690cggnp38u3nc0ulvqukems49se5uv16ajco_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjm9or1c1h2bs)**

[** STAND WITH ME
HELP ME UNSEAT JOE MANCHIN-> **](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0mqhv1omblqkmav46ftjodp6a931h5eoee93peo_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjm9or1c1h2bs)
**Joe Manchin in the Senate means advancing Biden 's failed liberal agenda every day. **

That's how we got The Inflation Reduction Act with its 87,000 new IRS agents.

West Virginians don't need the IRS breathing down their necks,_**nor do you.**_ The voters of the Mountain State have put their faith in me to be their governor over the last six years - **[now I'm asking them, and you, to put your trust in me and help send me to the United States Senate.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zrum031cf90iecld12m2t3bjh6hff2m78n5v8g58_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjm9or1c1h2bs)**

As West Virginia's next United States Senator, I will fight for stronger borders and law and order. I'll defend our energy jobs, cut middle-class taxes, end wasteful liberal spending, **and keep radical woke politics out of our kids ' classrooms**.

BUT - **[without your help right now](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z58sct5cvjv2vhmov4a8qpe9kpd2gf8l7ou4ehe8_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjm9or1c1h2bs)** , none of this will be possible. Joe Manchin has more than $9 million in his campaign accounts, and Democrats in D.C. will spend hundreds of millions to defend this seat because they know that without West Virginia, they can kiss their majority goodbye.

Can my team and I count on your support tonight? We need to make a big splash because Democrats are watching. **[Even if you can only chip in $1 right now](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zit3vspcc2lc4ij352f3c0dcru1gtnq4ut3qubr8_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjm9or1c1h2bs)** , I assure you it'll be the best investment you've ever made.

[** STAND WITH ME
HELP ME UNSEAT JOE MANCHIN-> **](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z34ceinv9ec3792ta0e3fvuk65mgq6nbpcbgnq7g_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdjm9or1c1h2bs)
Fellow Conservative, I'm a patriot. I truly am, and our country really means a lot to me. I'm not running out of self-interest. I'm running to serve.

Thank you - **I hope you 'll come along for the ride**.

Sincerely,

Republican for U.S. Senate

| **MEET JIM**

Gov. Jim Justice is a conservative leader, successful businessman, high school basketball coach, and devoted family man. Before being elected, Gov. Justice led over 100 companies, creating thousands of jobs.

Gov. Justice has delivered on his promise of diversifying West Virginia's economy. He enacted the largest personal income tax cut in state history. He protects traditional values and has been recognized as a pro-life champion, signing more pro-life legislation into law than any governor in state history. As an avid outdoorsman, he vigorously defends the Second Amendment. He is passionate about mentoring young people and serves as the head coach of his local high school basketball team.

Gov. Justice and his wife, First Lady Cathy Justice, have been best friends since high school. They recently celebrated their 46th wedding anniversary. The Governor and the First Lady have two adult children and spend time spoiling four grandchildren. body:
Why hitting these goals is essential

| |
---
| | |
Friend,

With the last day of April fast approaching, I wanted to take a couple moments to explain why we set goals each month and why hitting these goals is essential to elect Nikki Haley as the next President of the United States.

First and foremost, the monthly fundraising goals we set help us stay on track financially. Running for president is an expensive endeavor! It is amazing all the costs that pop up when trying to talk to hundreds of millions of voters. We need to make sure that we have the resources we need to reach everyone with Nikki’s positive message. Setting a goal each month helps us stay focused and stay accountable to Nikki and the entire team.

Our monthly fundraising goals are also a way for us to measure our progress. Every time we meet or exceed our fundraising goal, it shows that Nikki's message is resonating and gaining traction with voters. The confidence we build when we reach or exceed our goal allows us to bring on new staff, launch new ads, and invest in new ways to reach every American.

Finally, the monthly fundraising goals we set are a way for supporters to get involved and make a real impact. **Every dollar you give helps us spread Nikki’s message, and ultimately elect Nikki Haley as the next President of the United States. **

We know that setting and meeting monthly goals is a big and stressful task, but we also know that it's essential if we want to compete at the highest level. That's why we're asking for **[your help today](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c665397%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=a%2bITZI7nnuOkd9udNYzReA&sysid=1 "your help today")**. **April is only a couple days from being over and we still need some additional support to hit our April goal. **

Thank you so much for considering our request, and for all the support you've given us so far. **None of this would be possible without you!** Together, we can elect Nikki Haley and save our great country.

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE FRIDAY, APRIL 28
PHOTO RELEASE: GREATER GEORGIA HOSTS FIRST ANNUAL LEGISLATIVE AWARDS CEREMONY (ATLANTA) - On Wednesday, Greater Georgia hosted the first annual Greater Georgia Legislative Awards Ceremony. The event, which drew a crowd of over 200 guests, was held to honor conservative lawmakers and their accomplishments during the 2023 legislative session. Honored guest speakers included Governor Brian P. Kemp, First Lady Marty Kemp, Lt. Governor Burt Jones, and Speaker of the House Jon Burns.
Award recipients from the Georgia State Senate included President Pro Tem John F. Kennedy and Senators Jason Anavitarte, Max Burns, Shawn Still, and Brian Strickland. From the State House, award recipients included Speaker Pro Tem Jan Jones and Representatives Houston Gaines, Scott Hilton, Soo Hong, and Bruce Williamson.

sponsor:

Dear Friend,

Your participation in Hillsdale
College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is
requested.

Your response will only take a few
minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and
the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the
proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court
differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the
bench.

Do you agree that the role of the
Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and
NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

YES

NO

Even worse, progressives dismayed by
recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with
additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put
it in a Boston Globe op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to
a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by
four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you
today...

What is your opinion about the Supreme
Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me
using the College's National Survey on the United States Supreme
Court right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form
effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the proper
role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution
instead of legislating from the bench.

body:

With a heavy heart, I just announced I’m parting ways with Newsmax. My show reached millions and helped viewers see what’s _really_ happening in our country. Something the Mainstream Media fails to do time and time again.

| | | [READ MY FULL STATEMENT >>](https://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c79096%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=MdWFSrVWhH2lS4X7Ut1gqQ&sysid=1 "READ MY FULL STATEMENT")

The 2024 election will be the single most important one in the history of our country. Joe Biden and Democrats in Congress have set our country into a tailspin. It’s an emergency situation and we’re running dangerously short on time to change course.

We have our work cut out for us ahead of 2024:

- Expand our razor-thin Majority in the House
- Win back the Senate and send Chuck Schumer into retirement

Unfortunately, that last point is the most important. Why? Because no one works harder than strong Conservatives like you. And Republicans are WINNING on the issues - they can’t outsmart us when we’re the ones fighting for freedom, defending our country and flag, and resisting their radical woke agenda.

But Democrats have a MAJOR advantage in fundraising thanks to their armies of Hollywood megadonors and woke Liberals whipping out their credit cards whenever they flip on MSNBC.

win in 2024, it’s going to take all of us standing up RIGHT NOW. ")**_

That’s why I’m teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise for the FIRST TIME THIS YEAR. We ran the numbers on what it’ll take to outraise the Democrats and pull off an overwhelming victory.

We came to the conclusion that if every last one of you gave between $27 and $54, we would have the resources to MAX OUT all our voter contact budgets, GOTV operations, and volunteer recruitment efforts.

_In other words ... if everyone here steps up RIGHT NOW, the Democrats would suffer a defeat like nothing we’ve ever seen before._

**But that’s a big “if” - it requires 100% participation. **

This plan falls apart if too many folks sit out. We need everyone on board to pull this off.

So I’ll cut to the chase.

_**[From the bottom of my heart, would you be willing to make a meaningful contribution between $27 and $54? If we can pull this off, we’ll make history.](https://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c79098%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vXq6KO3ugmFLEqu6TaooUg&sysid=1 "From the bottom of my

Are you in?

Last night I was in West Virginia to help Jim Justice announce his United States Senate campaign. | [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61748215:WYu-vWDNc:m:1:877327319:F9EB5DD9F6AF7D01D44F603878208E18:r)

Fellow American,

If you think the country is going in the wrong direction, you are right.

We've got to **SECURE THE SENATE**.

That's why I was in West Virginia with one of America's GREATEST governors - Jim Justice - and America's favorite "First Dog" - Babydog.

Right before Jim officially announced his candidacy for the United States Senate, I pulled him aside to record a video for you, Fellow American. **[Will you take 50 seconds to watch this video that Jim Justice, Babydog, and I recorded for you?](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61748215:WYu-vWDNc:m:1:877327319:F9EB5DD9F6AF7D01D44F603878208E18:r)**

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61748215:WYu-vWDNc:m:1:877327319:F9EB5DD9F6AF7D01D44F603878208E18:r)
The Dems in Washington are going to fight like tigers to keep this Senate seat blue. You and I both know that it's insane that West Virginia is represented by a Democrat when President Trump won by 38 points.

That's why I made the trip to West Virginia. Jim Justice is the only candidate in this race who can defeat a Dem who already has over $9 million in the bank.

Under Senate Democrats and Joe Biden, we are energy DEPENDENT. Our borders are not protected, and Russia and China are posing both short-term and long-term challenges to our nation's security. Here's how we can change that: **[elect Jim Justice to the United States Senate.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61748215:WYu-vWDNc:m:1:877327319:F9EB5DD9F6AF7D01D44F603878208E18:r)**

**[Help me help Jim Justice by making a split donation of $5 or even $20.24 before midnight tonight.](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61748215:WYu-vWDNc:m:1:877327319:F9EB5DD9F6AF7D01D44F603878208E18:r)** Your donation will go directly to Jim Justice to kick-start his campaign AND help us **SECURE THE SENATE** in key races.

I am counting on you - and so is Jim (and Babydog). Don't let us down.

Thanks,

[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61748215:WYu-vWDNc:m:1:877327319:F9EB5DD9F6AF7D01D44F603878208E18:r)
Lindsey Graham

P.S. I am trying to help Jim Justice raise as much as possible in the first 24 hours of his United States Senate campaign. **[Every dollar will help. Please chip in $5 or more before midnight!](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61748215:WYu-vWDNc:m:1:877327319:F9EB5DD9F6AF7D01D44F603878208E18:r)**

subject: RE: campaign toplines (04/28/2023)
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Gillibrand for Senate
body:
| | |
---
Friend, I just left a meeting with my senior campaign team, and I need to share some important toplines from our conversation:

## Tucker Carlson Warns of “One-Party State”
Tucker Carlson issues his [first public statement](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszzFv8yAQgOFfA1ui48BwDAyfPslbOlXqaFHAMS02kX1J1H9fqV07v8Or5-0yXWJtdbu-xLUEnvsUE9dHmcCckE6oJ5Q5zKVg0bIEZQktISojl4DWOExWJeU0JSAwZCl6TZCz9xBlDQiowSApAKXMeYZEyuQB3sEl47UwUHLlvp8_et14KXP76o-yn1NfZQsL8-0Q-p_AUeDIz8r82wSOr_f0Wfb_cW9H3wSOB0e-HwJHZQelnQXvtPGDIzdouYd8e9bW6mGdMHBdY20_D_6b_B0AAP__DHtUAA) since departing Fox News and makes no mention of the network or his own situation, focusing instead on the poor state of truth-telling in partisan media coverage. The calmly-delivered two-minute video, viewed tens of millions of times by mid-afternoon, served as backdrop to reams of speculation about where the top-rated host will go next. Will he [run for president](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2OqzAUBOCnMZ2RfXAMFBS3octtt0T-OYSzMTayTdC-_Sqpt_ykkWY0X_flbihQfPw3O051TYtxlV64CMVh4NAt0PhpRQTsGpykHkAPAFI126SF62-90nK0crBCjk4Pnbd6tErbm-kamkBAJxQMUggpVbsKN0jlb8KK3qmxY0qgp5py-50o1g3X8JNemFuX9iZMW61HYd0_BjOD-bqutm74OE32ZOI7w2A-C494FQbzu4vBbI78Rs9gzuSe_KJQUuT1dE_M3Jn84ZGxkMdYyQQe004RkfsUTfC85nM_eE6ReywmVio843HaQM7E0uTJHxeFQEX3TInHbih8Bte___sNAAD__6A1c3Y)? Or perhaps star in [his own late-night show or podcast](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vwyAQQH8N3oiOA39kYOjiLV07WgSOQIvBsi-J8u-rdO78pPek93VZLi6XXG-fbiXLsS3Oc37QAkbiJFEv2AUbiZB0R1YNEw4TojJdsjqC7q9jP6nRD1cCPwAGMjAC9sG7vssWATUYnBSAUuYUwU_KhB6uMHpz1sIAhcxtP323XDlRLK_2oP3k29oVm5i3Q-gPgbPAmROlXMqbCZxTW6nS8xA4rxSyEzjr86g0DvKZHB8yV8l3_0O79G4vR6uHjHe-7yS3QpVfskXZNs6tvh3dbsP2zKXkYxiFgdvq8l-q4_-v_AYAAP__7e5jjg)? Others wonder how the vacuum at Fox News will affect the [Republican primaries](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPqzAQhH-N6YyWtUNIQfEaurz2lciYJd53BiN7Ey7__sRJ110zGmlGmtH37z7eHUfeHn_dSr0saXRe-EUjWI2dRjNiNfcLEZKpqG_aDtsOsbFV6NHRNFvrofOTo-tszDK3rTHGA3qcuop7BDRgsWsAmsbWC_iusfMFJrh6ezPKAs0sKdf_E28SaInv9KJc-7RWsQ8ie1Hmj8JB4XAcR72nyMI-nQWFw0ZHiSRCuSgcfkK98SNIfCsczn2FA9jTnxLSoeXpPyhr73IsaSuaPll0phLcTkVLIJ1pf06Rvdv0nnl1-a0B4GYuN6hyP-8Hx8ilvSoLj9Vx_P4rv-P7CgAA__8GUHHu). Carlson had enormous influence in his sphere and there is no clear replacement. Indeed, [ratings spiked](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPozAQhX8NdEb24IBTuLiGLtdeiRx7HOZibGQmIfvvV2y95XtPevr0_bvNN0eJ8uOvW9FyLLPzTG-cpRZgBPQztMFGRMC-RasGA4MBULpdrNdqgNHEUTsMfojSKDkOGO6X4RpMgJYsSOilBqOkVEp3UXqjdLjIuxy9vvaNlhiIS-3-F8q8YExf5Y2182Vtk12Yt73p_zQwNTAdx9FRDrhhDpi586V7PRuYMh77OZeaQgOTW7GSd2f12sVWEjH5M_HLP7EK72raSxaRKgYRy0ecB4IPYsYq3hSwCMYP7-IOPYymv3QLr6mtNmwHpUT7MDZaPlZH6QeUf_f2HQAA__8R73DC) at conservative network Newsmax in the days following his departure, and dropped at Fox.
## Economic Growth Stalling, Biden Dropping
The U.S. economy grew an [anemic 1.1 percent](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFywyAQAF-DOjRwIEsqKNKoc9qUGiwO-RIEDmAT_z7j1Om32N2P83q2FCju7_ZAU31a7VbpgavQHCYOaoXOGY8IqDo08jTBaQKQurua2epxnAfAQQkFfpwvymmhnHZ-xMkPHRkQoISGSQohpe692Cap3SAuYtz0rJgW6Kim3H8mivWKPjzTA3O_paML5lrrrTD1xmBhsLTWep9-LvdCEUt5MQyWw-YvrIXBci8ctxTT8eR7xsYll_yGecNYuadcKv--21wx80J7tK9oXkJqLrXYZeNujUKgchqZFvthKfxZ1P-n_AYAAP__SdxlPg) in the first quarter, short of estimates and the third straight quarter of decline. It had grown 3.2 percent in third quarter 2022 and only 2.6 percent in fourth quarter, a clear trend line downward. Economists blamed [investment and inventory declines](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFyhCAUAL8GOxx4cAoFRRq7S5vS4eSJJHgYeHdO_j5zqdNttzv7cZ2vPuV0j-9-R0drmf1C6Ymz0BwMBzVDF9yKCKg6dHIwMBgAqbvNjbf1ErT1qKT1JoAWdhzVaoeA3lpjuuRAgBIajBRCSt2vYjFSh4u4iXHRVjEtMCQqtf8s6U4brvmnPLH2S9m77DaiozH1xmBiMJ3n2e--fiEd2S_YlxoZTC8Dg0noF48MphgOHms5aePpzmlD_uCNn77xlh8xprbx7Bvx74evhJXB1FUXjjPlnNowMi3i7lP-S6D_j_wGAAD___m_YLw) as culprits for the slowdown, raising questions about whether the nation was heading towards [a recession](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL3O4yAQRZ_G7ohgIBgXFNuky7ZbWvwMNisMFowS5e1X2for7z3N0fnz3J4ul1z33-5ES6ltLlB-4cYVA8NAbjBHmxAB5YxWaAPaAAg1H9bJiA69CuDCKtd7gntIGtcAwnivljlb4CC5AiM4F0LdEg9GqHjnni9BrXJSHGOm1m9_W650YCqf9sJ-C-2ciz2IrjHJXxM8Jni4q-J7fNF3dMqh4ASPjgHHyK2yPV4MQ6vt_LBcU3H0fXMl7DiIdUc42N7bmw7mNSx6XRepDefcxwjeC_AxJKmS9GbuNl7vXEoeepkU30-Xy38t-rnSvwAAAP__qNVpew). The shrinking economy has political implications as well. In [Gallup's latest poll,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAQRb_GdEbjwQZSuHgNXV67JTL2QGY1wRZ4k83fr7L11vdK5-h8XOdrYOF9-x_u5Oua5xArP2gGq3HU2M3YJL8SIXUNedOP2I-IxjY3n8LiKKVg4hDRdReHKwZYHODQB1hjwx4BO7A4GgBjbLtCHI1NDhYYor10ygIlrvloPzPv9UarvPKDjjbmeyP-Vms5VfdP4aRw2ul5tlsQ-SrvXeFUsojCyYFDQIXTwol2vdDG-6kPIqFYOe964aQlP3V5Q3Q56Hwf46sNZ_luDp_Kk0X47AdlYbsHll-B-nePnwAAAP__PZFiTA) President Biden's approval numbers dropped to 37 percent, the lowest since he became president.
## Russian Pranksters Dupe Fed Chairman
Two Russian [pranksters tricked](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAURb8Gb1jwjB0yMHTxlq4dLQzP8WswWEBiuV9fpXO3K13p6Oh83aabpUDx_mk3NHVJk3WVXjgJxUFz6CZovFkQAbsGjRw0DBpAqmY1chgA-qvX2g3oO1S9lBKk1c5B31toyICATijQUggpVbsIp6XyvZjFxalrx5RATzXl9jtRrCsu4UwvzK1LWxPMWuteWPfBYGQwHsfRuji798lgfKMZjEK994XBuKcDQ-D-uaPn88nzsxSyke_ZxkepmAt3wdJG8c5r4jPy5yNbilj4DwaM5XGevF3rFpps_H5QCFSGC1PivlkKf071_0S_AQAA__9Xomd4) Fed Chairman Jerome Powell into thinking he was on a phone call with Ukraine President Zelenskyy. News of the prank, which happened earlier this year, came out Thursday after [video](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz79uwyAQgPGngS3RcWAwA0MXd0qXDh0tAodNhf_Ivibq21dq187f8On3cRtvsba6Tm9xocBlG2Pi-qARzAX7C-oRZQ6FCElLCsr2aHtEZeQc7thlTBY6r1WxzloVMaYcPbmSLTlZAwJqMNgrAKXMtUDqlckd3MEl47UwQLnydlw_t7ryTKV9bw86rmlbZAsz834K_SJwEDjwszL_NYHDO9M-0zq-Up3oEDicHPnrFDgo26nOeme8A43Ge9TyCHl_1tbqaZ0wMC2xtt8J_2_-CQAA__8_JlVi) of the call surfaced on Russian TV. Powell apparently said nothing controversial to the callers as he discussed the Fed strategy for bringing down inflation. The two pranksters, known as Vovan and Lexus, are known allies of Russian President Vladimir Putin and [have previously pranked](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszz1uhDAQQOHT2B1oZvyDU7hIQ7dpUyJsD4sjAyvsLMrto6Te-klP-j5v023OJe_3j3lj35ZjmmPLT55Ad-Q6UhPJ5BdmYiXZo3VkHRFqufo422AsGQeJMEBSLil0BiEsytqBZPYEpECTQwBE3S8QHepkIMAQ9ZsSGjjldpz915H3tvJSfo4nn308Nln82tqjCvUuaBQ0XtfVhxD_mqBx56sKGsN3zTvX2lmjUeNg5OnT48ql5GoHoeG-zbn8_9pr3m8AAAD___JtTnc) former German Chancellor Angela Merkel, Britain's Prince Harry and Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau.

I am the most conservative candidate in this race and we need to let Republican primary voters know that. Also, the later date of June 20th has created some problems for some voters, so we need to reach them now to let know that early voting starts May 5th.

But you don't have to wait until Saturday to help. Our campaign office is open during the week. [Please email us](mailto:chris@chaseforva.com) to let us know you can help.

And join us Monday night at 7pm for the Chesterfield VA TEA Party monthly meeting at Great American Ranch.

We look forward to seeing you soon.

body:

---
| | | | | | | | | | | [](https://click.action.jjforcongress.com/?qs=f69418445a42a6e5d95f45a731b0ead448f69bd56905592d69f76f75a1fbac403860802fd2daca216edea9788fd01aa2dc9a64444190c44b)
---
| | | Peter, Can you believe it's been over 100 days since I started serving in Congress? In that time:
* **I fought for American families** , passing a landmark energy bill and voting for the Parents Bill of Rights.
* **I stood up for Michigan,** leading an effort to protect our beautiful Great Lakes from a new Canadian nuclear waste facility.
* **And I passed my first piece of legislation** : a bill that protects Medicare and Social Security from cuts during any debt ceiling negotiations. We've got to keep our promises to America's seniors, and I'm proud that this is my first bill.

_Peter, I 'm doing everything I can to keep the promises I made to the American people when I went to Washington._ _And I 'm just getting started._ After 100 days, I hope it's clear: **I 'm 100% ALL-IN on America**. It's why the Democrats ALREADY have our seat on their list of top targets. They think that MI-10 is one of the seats they can flip to retake the majority. **But I 've got a surprise for them: There's NO WAY I'm backing down.** **[Are you with me, Co-Pilot? body:
You may know me from my roles in movies like Apollo 13 and The Green Mile or the CBS television series CSI NY-- but it was in 1994 and playing the role of Lt. Dan in Forrest Gump, that my life changed and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders.

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=36ca9d27a91547bfacf56e4969ec37aa&_e=-LNxfVwMwJjWOVfOfM0hKHlsC05vJZvH8sBTQLwEeYYkWTVhB0oyMazgppVP3-szbj4CCqge2Bm5WyIViOWkcvjcmSOVlJOkqM1BPE7y81cR-htiy21HaON4SssbnfAEdR5ZOb3-QXrK2A8lLpmt8vYIjL6gNDhi8MRGbCTy2w7CAYw1pUzH7Phme7cJfzS9NyjBdtPOHHUdvmYnymikYRrr_JPYgqgoFZ-ExTveht_TNxQR_0VFIusdhY_6LFaSosxDmzMMmOpQnKBsOZ9YuNafLL0fWS5IuyO_CORw45HUx38CniFJvt52cu9l8IDO)

Fellow American, It's Gary Sinise here. You may know me from my roles in movies like _Apollo 13 _and _The Green Mile _or the CBS television series _CSI NY_ -- but it was in 1994 and playing the role of Lt. Dan in _Forrest Gump,_ that my life changed and inspired my enduring connection to our defenders, veterans, and first responders. **This year, I 'm honored to again serve as an Honorary Grand Marshal for the National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C.** The National Memorial Day Parade is an event like no other ... and this year, the American Veterans Center is bringing it BACK in full force, with 5,000+ participants marching down Constitution Avenue before a crowd of 250,000+ in-person, as well as T.V. broadcast that reaches 100 million households around the country. [**Fellow American, the National Memorial Day Parade is PRIMARILY FUNDED by private contributions, including from generous Americans like you. Will you help chip in today to help support the Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, or more?**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=36ca9d27a91547bfacf56e4969ec37aa&_e=-LNxfVwMwJjWOVfOfM0hKHlsC05vJZvH8sBTQLwEeYYkWTVhB0oyMazgppVP3-szbj4CCqge2Bm5WyIViOWkcvjcmSOVlJOkqM1BPE7y81cR-htiy21HaON4SssbnfAEdR5ZOb3-QXrK2A8lLpmt8vYIjL6gNDhi8MRGbCTy2w45QrzCIxzK3xoG-bBwhdElxTLMmoCPfFbWuwGZdJQ-lVgN9nJD1knj3YEZv5bE6-2KbT3gcikHhP32KW9ZDu6HSGo2DmXg41q6_CZYmuxxA6WhwHupFCLBrSa-qGtFq-aEzpnbGD1FrAX_J-3ZF_b-)

[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=36ca9d27a91547bfacf56e4969ec37aa&_e=-LNxfVwMwJjWOVfOfM0hKHlsC05vJZvH8sBTQLwEeYYkWTVhB0oyMazgppVP3-szbj4CCqge2Bm5WyIViOWkcvjcmSOVlJOkqM1BPE7y81cR-htiy21HaON4SssbnfAEdR5ZOb3-QXrK2A8lLpmt8vYIjL6gNDhi8MRGbCTy2w6wAGergtWm80cvD97c2Gt5YlA0drvgmMr5DcwwDMBehK6kX26vLp3IXTz5rxIyo_YKfQkG6bOLXwabzACB5DAXMXkQN6f7eEnQTcBoQ9KRdtwfdMs6ZaPv6BBdTMjihHp-WQzdUzhb3HbGWKf4Ndrt)

When the American Veterans Center first called me 18 years ago and invited me to the National Memorial Day Parade, I was honored to join the event to remember our fallen heroes. The American Veterans Center revived the Parade in 2005 after it had been dormant for nearly 70 years. And this year, they're bringing the Parade back better than ever. Every American should be proud that generations of our brave servicemen and servicewomen, from the last of our "Greatest Generation" heroes of World War II to our veterans from Afghanistan and Iraq, will get the public thanks for their service that they deserve this year. But I know that the defenders and families of the fallen who will join me in the National Memorial Day Parade will be thinking of their friends and loved ones who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country -- the brave Americans we honor on Memorial Day. **Sadly, our country is losing hundreds of World War II veterans each day, so the mission of the National Memorial Day Parade is _more important now than ever_ -- as this year's event may be the LAST opportunity for our WWII heroes to commemorate their friends who never came home.** [**Please make your most generous contribution of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, to support the National Memorial Day Parade and make it the tribute that our nation 's heroes deserve.**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=36ca9d27a91547bfacf56e4969ec37aa&_e=-LNxfVwMwJjWOVfOfM0hKHlsC05vJZvH8sBTQLwEeYYkWTVhB0oyMazgppVP3-szbj4CCqge2Bm5WyIViOWkcvjcmSOVlJOkqM1BPE7y81cR-htiy21HaON4SssbnfAEdR5ZOb3-QXrK2A8lLpmt8vYIjL6gNDhi8MRGbCTy2w49xrMEn0COshJYmA3WY5qtnX-gI0r38Cu9wR5dqCP-c6UYJc9jAZOQepteettWS9junVD4G8-J72Izm4oTepfrJibT6gf3xywZj4IRQBnOjiwO-M0yhfmuzOyfqwSguTEevugX1yTUFGXUE7LbfZ-G)
---
[**Support the National Memorial Day Parade**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=36ca9d27a91547bfacf56e4969ec37aa&_e=-LNxfVwMwJjWOVfOfM0hKHlsC05vJZvH8sBTQLwEeYYkWTVhB0oyMazgppVP3-szbj4CCqge2Bm5WyIViOWkcvjcmSOVlJOkqM1BPE7y81cR-htiy21HaON4SssbnfAEdR5ZOb3-QXrK2A8lLpmt8vYIjL6gNDhi8MRGbCTy2w7tBL-D2jUnTISIGJfdQsQomdw5rTkTqnCwA64pEksCLY6xVxFVPO7e_zhQxAqIXMJxWGVxSnd1zoq4SpuiPvGdCr93guV9kNat29sw-QM0RGxeg0ijZJkogseW_hozXqrvtYbVlMT1T6I9RAKhEKXP)
---
The National Memorial Day Parade costs a fraction of other major public events to put on each year. In fact, the entire parade costs about as much as just THREE balloons in the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade or TWO floats in the Rose Bowl Parade! _That means that every dollar that 's contributed by a generous American like you makes a difference for this important event._ Your support of the American Veterans Center not only helps the Parade, but also supports great programs like:
* Recording hundreds of oral histories of veterans from World War II to today before we lose these stories forever.

* Holding our National Youth Summit which allows young students a chance to hear firsthand from veterans from WWII, Korea, and Vietnam.

* Producing veteran-focused T.V. documentaries and specials that remind Americans of the price of our freedom.

[**Please join me in support of the National Memorial Day Parade with a gift of $25, $50, $75, $150, $250, $500, or more right now.**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=36ca9d27a91547bfacf56e4969ec37aa&_e=-LNxfVwMwJjWOVfOfM0hKHlsC05vJZvH8sBTQLwEeYYkWTVhB0oyMazgppVP3-szbj4CCqge2Bm5WyIViOWkcvjcmSOVlJOkqM1BPE7y81cR-htiy21HaON4SssbnfAEdR5ZOb3-QXrK2A8lLpmt8vYIjL6gNDhi8MRGbCTy2w6D3gEs3rMgEvj6Gst2tWUPMTJ9E88VETda0-knyxeZjuxUQCybYCFH87q5CVSh7kKIPKDGaqLTfhNgZaGeiWvgbdLxNWKoirq0otGWFIMx3EODpqeq8dFpggDDuBd-4Dv7SXhkXRLHmjZRCi2wtsVU) But no matter how much you can give to this important cause, I want to ask something additional of you.

On Memorial Day -- this year and every year -- please join me in honoring those who made the ultimate sacrifice for our freedoms. Come to the National Memorial Day Parade in D.C. Visit a local veterans' cemetery. Send a note to a family of the fallen. Or simply take a quiet moment to think about the men and women who gave their lives to defend OUR country. _I believe while we can never do enough to express our gratitude to our defenders, veterans, and first responders, we can always do a little more._ Fellow American, thank you for your support of America's heroes, and please -- [**if you're able, make a gift to help fund the National Memorial Day Parade right now.**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=36ca9d27a91547bfacf56e4969ec37aa&_e=-LNxfVwMwJjWOVfOfM0hKHlsC05vJZvH8sBTQLwEeYYkWTVhB0oyMazgppVP3-szbj4CCqge2Bm5WyIViOWkcvjcmSOVlJOkqM1BPE7y81cR-htiy21HaON4SssbnfAEdR5ZOb3-QXrK2A8lLpmt8vYIjL6gNDhi8MRGbCTy2w4v93EblwDrc3_D4rdZKtbJkjxVKTUeNyjkV0T-DzfyX7AU9K3HIYTp8qq6aZM8MpQvyqrGhleTb6q07cLVfM8rZPyc6-fjkc91T04Bsxc5EtDhSXk-FPOmC7KHa_g4Ni6G_V5qpvHk1EnlTdJooJff)
---
Sincerely,

Gary Sinise
Honorary Grand Marshal
National Memorial Day Parade

subject: How do you see the Supreme Court?
body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zi1cil01mmqlq5caa1tecedtl76s907gatgbibgo_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdie1pb2cth2bs)
---
| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zq2shq6dqqvm65ehrvmtilv6qt1v16a55ug6d09o_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdie1pb2cth2bs) [NO](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zon7o2rnp8dpp8a52kmd45c4rggi47qhohtp8khg_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdie1pb2cth2bs) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ztqkojhpgm87go5rjp5uh6dnea28opf6uo50ada0_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdie1pb2cth2bs)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zr6m4qk3g4inh51jph56cub2d13veat60ofn4t0o_rp22sh2s8i66o72cdie1pb2cth2bs)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

# _That's a Wrap_
---
Early this morning, the gavels fell for the last time and _those_ two words were spoken (_sine die_) as the state House and Senate adjourned for the year. Just a few months ago, Hoosiers overwhelmingly sent Republicans back to the statehouse to continue to deliver results for them. And this session, that's exactly what they did. Working together, Governor Eric Holcomb and our Republican-led legislature took bold action that, as Governor Holcomb has said, "will better the lives of Hoosiers and build a better today and stronger tomorrow." Through the biennial budget, Republicans have created endless opportunities for our state. That includes the opportunity to keep more of _your_ hard-earned dollars, to skill up more Hoosiers, to build stronger and more vibrant communities, to improve Hoosiers' health and wellbeing, and for parents to choose the best school for their children. But that's _certainly_ not all. Through separate legislation, they have worked to lower healthcare and prescription costs, provide property tax relief, keep dangerous criminals off our streets, protect renters, and plan for our state's fiscal future. There were many wins for Hoosiers this session. And we're excited to share them with you over the coming weeks. Enjoy this week's newsletter. Sincerely,
---
---
Chairman Kyle Hupfer
---
|
---

# **Governor Holcomb's Week That Was**
---

# _A Legislative Session With 'Generational Impact'_
---
| | [| | |
---|---|---](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/8e8d6fa11cae673a/a6614559f9a32c14c3d6b838967d376c/40313 "Governor Holcomb's 2023 Sine Die Press Conference")
_**Governor Eric Holcomb** held an early morning press conference after both chambers adjourned sine die. You can watch it by clicking above._**
---
In a (very) early morning Friday press conference, **Governor Eric Holcomb** lauded the conclusion of the legislative session that enacted his 2023 Next Level Agenda, noting it will have a "generational impact." **Here's what he had to say in a news release:** “First and foremost, we balanced our 10th straight budget which enables us to strategically prioritize key areas in health, education and workforce that will elevate Indiana to the Next Level. I’m proud of what was accomplished this legislative session and through collaboration and hard work we will be able to make transformational investments that will better the lives of Hoosiers and build a better today and stronger tomorrow.” **The details:** **Gov. Holcomb** provided an overview of the key components of his 2023 Next Level Agenda that the legislature approved.
* Read it **[here](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/8e8d6fa11cae673a/f203a6a211783f15c3d6b838967d376c/40313)**.

---
| | |
---
# _Election Day is Just Four Days Away_
---
Election Day is just**** four days away. However, Hoosiers still have time to vote early, including this Saturday and Monday until noon (local time). **Be prepared:** You can visit **[indianavoters.com](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/8e8d6fa11cae673a/dffee0523cb05184c3d6b838967d376c/40313)** to see who is on your ballot and find your voting location and hours.

|

# _Save the Date: Municipal Candidate Training_
---
---
We recently announced our 2023 municipal candidate training —**** IN IT TO WIN: Victory in Indiana's Cities & Towns. **Details:** The training will be held on**** Saturday, June 10, 2023,**** at the University of Indianapolis. More details will be forthcoming. **What to expect: **This one-day session will include breakout sessions with industry experts and consultants on all things grassroots, finance, and communications, to give candidates and their campaigns the winning edge for November.
---
|

# _Chairman Kyle Hupfer Named Board Chairman of GOP Data Firm_
---
**Chairman Kyle Hupfer** was selected to the board of directors of Data Trust and elected its new chairman on Wednesday. **About Data Trust:** The company provides the "best, most affordable" voter and electoral data to Republicans and conservative campaigns, parties, and advocacy groups like the Republican National Committee (RNC), National Republican Congressional Committee (NRCC), and National Republican Senatorial Committee (NRSC). **From the Data Trust[blog](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/8e8d6fa11cae673a/3e2c87e230789138c3d6b838967d376c/40313):** "A Board of Directors committed to Republican success ensures that Data Trust acts as a steward of Republican data and carefully reinvests revenues toward expanding and improving the data products and services it offers the Republican ecosystem. **Kyle’s** impressive political and private sector experience will make a significant contribution to that mission."
---
|
---
# _In Tuesday Reelection Announcement, Joe Biden Says 'Let's Finish This Job'_ 🥴
---
In a video published early Tuesday, just two days after **[70 percent](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/8e8d6fa11cae673a/5fcb33e538b2b9ccc3d6b838967d376c/40313)** of Americans, including 51 percent of Democrats, said that Joe Biden shouldn't run for reelection, Joe Biden officially announced his fourth presidential bid. **The big picture:** At the time of his announcement, President Biden's approval rating stood at [**42.6 percen** t](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/8e8d6fa11cae673a/9717a97e4eac247dc3d6b838967d376c/40313), according the _Real Clear Politics_ polling data, while only **[25 percent](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/8e8d6fa11cae673a/2f601501225876e2c3d6b838967d376c/40313)** of the country thought the country was moving in the "right direction." **What wasn't said:** The three-minute announcement video fails to mention a single first-term accomplishment and ends by President Biden saying, "Let’s finish this job." **Our comment:** With those numbers, we'd rather him not. Here's what **Chairman Kyle Hupfer** had to say about the announcement: "Over the next 19 months, Joe Biden will take his record in front of the American people, seemingly unaware of what it actually is. While it may be hard for him to remember given that it spans nearly five decades, the last three years shouldn't be. Inflation crisis, border crisis, energy crisis, foreign affairs crisis — those should all ring a bell. It's a record of failure that will be too large for him to hide from this time, even with more rooms to choose from than just his basement."
---
|
---
# _Whitley Yates Named to IBJ's '40 Under 40'_
---
---
_**Whitley Yates** was named to the 2023 class of the IBJ's '40 Under 40' last Friday. _
---
**Whitley Yates** , our director of diversity and engagement, was recently named to the 2023 class of the _Indianapolis Business Journal's (IBJ)_ "40 Under 40" last Friday. **About the honor:** Each year, the _IBJ_ recognizes 40 individuals in metro Indianapolis that have made a mark in their profession before the age of 40. Among hundreds of nominees, **Whitley** was selected as one of the 40. **Please join us in congratulating her!** **More:** You can read her full **[profile](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/8e8d6fa11cae673a/64826fdcd66ed492c3d6b838967d376c/40313)** in the _IBJ._ "**Whitley Yates** is the first person to hold the position of director of diversity and engagement at the Indiana Republican Party, a distinction she embraces. 'I do what I do because I am distinctly aware that I have the power to cultivate places of belonging and inclusion where uncomfortability once resided,' she said. 'I do it because making connections for the community could create a change larger than me, and I could be a catalyst to inspire those who will come after me.'"
---

# _RNC Launches Real-Time Biden Fact Checker_
---
The Republican National Committee (RNC) on Monday launched **[factcheckbiden.com](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/8e8d6fa11cae673a/846d45bbd9cb4f94c3d6b838967d376c/40313)** , a website solely dedicated to fact checking President Biden in real time. **From the RNC Chairwoman:** “Not only has Biden created crisis after crisis, he lies about the damage that he’s done to our country. Whether it’s claiming that the border is secure, that our economy is strong, or that the botched withdrawal from Afghanistan was a success, Biden and his administration refuse to acknowledge the truth. The RNC will continue to hold Biden accountable for his lies, and in November 2024, the American people will too.” **More:** In addition to rapid fact checks, the site will provide real-time messaging on Biden for our activists who sign up for email updates through the website.

Through the biennial budget, Republicans have created endless opportunities for our state. Hello,

In 2022, no one gave my husband Adam Frisch a chance against Lauren Boebert.

Everywhere you looked, the political pundits were calling Colorado’s 3rd Congressional District “Safe Republican” or “Solid R.”

Nate Silver’s FiveThirtyEight only gave Adam a 3% chance of defeating Boebert. They projected he’d lose by over 45,000 votes!
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/62443320/403467474/-321553144?&amounts=15,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2528-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5Nzc2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYwMzczNTVhLWM1ZTUtZWQxMS04ZThiLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7OWBhIQGGFR9ru1OfaMD8MGR1Yqe0bRL4f9daX3GwGo=)
In the end, though, the race went to a recount. **Lauren Boebert won by just 546 votes, and Adam lost the closest race in the entire country.**

Because here’s what their “models” and “forecasts” didn’t factor in: Adam put in the work. He traveled 24,000 miles in our red pickup truck to every corner of the district. He met thousands and thousands of voters – and he listened.

Now, my husband’s running again, and I’ll be honest: The first campaign was hard. But defeating Lauren Boebert is just too important to sit this out. **Adam’s all-in to finish the job in 2024. I’m all-in. Can we count on you?**

name: Looping you in, Peter
subject: Re: making our streets safe again
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rick Scott for Florida
body:
| | | Peter,
---
The American dream wouldn’t be possible without our brave law enforcement officers.

They keep our streets safe so that our children can pursue their dreams, and they put their lives on the line to do it.

_But now, the Democrats are trying to ERASE them from our country._

| | | Dear Friend,

It’s no secret that reproductive freedom is under attack by Republicans across the country.

**Let me be clear: reproductive rights are human rights, and I am in this race for RI-01 to continue to ensure reproductive freedom is protected in our community.**

I’m thankful and proud that, because of the leadership of so many, the RI House passed the Equality in Abortion Coverage Act. I’m hopeful for swift action in the Senate, then onward to the Governor’s desk. It’s much needed progress as the GOP attacks these freedoms nationally.

As your representative in Congress, I will continue to champion and fight for reproductive freedom. There is so much at stake in this race, so if you’re with me, consider [chipping in today](https://gabeamo.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cc42fee5a4ff30fb7e2aead18&id=173798bc38&e=9651074c98) to keep up the fight. # Mayor Suarez Joins Vikram...
---
Dr. Mansharamani's most recent conversation is live and will be aired on The Pulse of New Hampshire this weekend. His guest was Francis Suarez, Mayor of Miami. You can listen to the show on the Pulse of New Hampshire app or wherever you get your podcasts (links to several sites are at the end of this email).
---
---
EPISODE 7: MAYOR FRANCIS SUAREZ
In the most recent episode, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Miami Mayor Francis Suarez. Mayor Suarez shares what it was like growing up as the oldest of four children and his path to being elected with 86% of the vote. They discuss how the Mayor navigated his career decisions, his approach to governance, his vision for America, and his love of New Hampshire (yes, New Hampshire!) barbecue.

---
EPISODE 6: GOVERNOR CHRIS SUNUNU
In the sixth episode, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Chris Sununu, Governor of the State of New Hampshire. Governor Sununu shares what it was like growing up as the seventh of eight children as well as a bit about his time at MIT. They discuss how the Governor navigated his early career decisions, the three ingredients he believes are responsible for New Hampshire's successes, and why he now prefers french toast to pancakes.
---
EPISODE 5: COMMISSIONER FRANK EDELBLUT
In the fifth episode of Navigating Uncertainty, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Frank Edelblut, Commissioner of Education for the State of New Hampshire. An accountant turned successful businessman, Commissioner Edelblut shared how he has navigated uncertainty in his personal life as well as his thinking around several important education topics. Topics addressed include charter schools, education financing, parental rights, and the increasing importance of lifelong learning.
---

EPISODE 4: COMMISSIONER TAYLOR CASWELL
In the fourth episode of Navigating Uncertainty, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Commissioner Taylor Caswell, head of the Department of Business and Economic Affairs for the State of New Hampshire. A native of Littleton, Commissioner Caswell shared his philosophy around navigating a career in the public and private sectors, his hopes for a restoration of civil civic engagement, and his love of the outdoors (and cookies)!
---

EPISODE 3: VIVEK RAMASWAMY
In episode three, Dr. Mansahramani speaks with entrepreneur, one-time stand up comic, and prolific author Vivek Ramaswamy about the American dream and what it was like growing up in Ohio. In addition to exploring the power of annoyance, they discuss the key decisions that took Vivek from the Ivy League to a very successful biotech company (with a stint as a comedian along the way)...and his recent announcement to enter the US Presidential contest as part of his quest to help restore an American identity.
---
EPISODE 2: GENERAL LORI ROBINSON
In the second episode, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with General Lori Robinson, USAF (Ret), a New Hampshire native who served as the Commander of North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD). General Robinson was also America's first female Combatant Commander and served as head of Northern Command. She is an awesome leader, dedicated America who has served the United States for decades, and all around amazing person. She has also faced (and successfully navigated) many forms of uncertainty on her path to becoming a four-star general.
---
EPISODE 1: MIKE ROGERS
In the first episode, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Mike Rogers, former chair of the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence, and former multi-term Congressman from Michigan. Mike served in the military and also fought organized crime as a member of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. He's a class act, a first-rate thinker, and a patriotic American who cares deeply about the United States and its future.

---
| |
---
---
|
---
|
Navigating Uncertainty is a show in which acclaimed global trend-watcher and futurist [Vikram Mansharamani](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001q5IK4Ed8ELCiie_ZQ942f-IE6CVMwJeW3v2jUXMZkI7YBz06rwnMtnpTPRE_NAPih9YPFzlLGPefFzlJZ4-F51kMAWW8LYU1Va_FMJ0nuqg0Xpn1Bvre7241UzU7KI3KVKVeUZFZnBVkvHkkirSG-A==&c=cU4uT1R5m8k87VaLnvNWpGnZ_tqABD1lo0atwy0ItUKAbFtnJ_VbaQ==&ch=4UTtXFRgFrohl9_V_k7C8xUXa7DlWmTeynSh-3-hR--sedZVpxDnjg==) dives into how leaders make decisions. Through long-form conversations that move beyond sound-bites, Dr. Mansharamani explores how some of the most successful people think about tough choices.
